name: sandbar-service

scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../../apps/web build && rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/client.ts --target bun --format esm --outdir dist --external sandbar-sdk --external sandbar-adapter --external zod --external modal && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit false --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist && bun flatten-declarations.mjs && cp -R ../store/migrations dist/migrations && cp -R ../../apps/web/dist dist/web

description: Optional self-hosted Sandbar service and HTTP client.
